newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian stocks end soft, ATX seen capped at 1,310.
newsitem.headline: Austrian stocks end soft, ATX seen capped at 1,310.

text.p: Austrian shares ended a particularly subdued session with minor losses on Friday.
Traders see the ATX index, which closed 0.1 percent or 1.24 points lower at 1,295.04, trading with a firm bias next week although gains are seen capped at 1,310 points.
"There are hardly any sellers in the market. The market environment is friendly," said one trader.
Of the ATX index's 21 blue chips, 10 fell, eight gained and three were unchanged by the close.
The day's top ATX gainer was microchip producer AMS, up 1.57 percent at 1,035 schillings, while oil and energy group OMV led decliners, shedding 1.27 percent to 1,556 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index fell 0.07 points, or 0.01 percent, to 473.85.
The July ATX future lost 7.2 points to 1,298.8 on turnover of 274 contracts.
